question: Across ten varied public five-second text-to-audiovisual requests, what are the complete-delivery time and success/failure of the fixed Ours and vpipe systems?
user_scope: Expand the existing two prompts to ten total, using high-quality web-sourced inspiration. Official FastH3 remains excluded.
runtime: Same installed Ours wheel and model bundle as accepted short-768p-01; unchanged vpipe executable, model assets and VDN recipe. Freeze exact source commit/config before launch.
changed_variable: Eight additional predeclared prompt/seed pairs. No runtime, precision, sampler, model or kernel tuning.
data_split: Public source adaptations, new to these fixed local systems in this batch; no held-out or unseen-training-data claim. All prompts and seeds fixed before generation.
order: case-major, Ours then vpipe; fixed order, no claim to remove order effects
timer: Fresh process through strict complete AV validation, including load, generation and delivery crop/trim; preparation/cooldown excluded, ordinary OS/Metal caches retained and prompt caches empty.
metrics: separate assistant visual inspection and user AV acceptance
aggregation: Report new eight and all ten separately. Pair only matching input/seed/spec. Describe mean, median, paired time ratios and total wait with cohort labels; no repeated-run confidence intervals or algorithm-only gain. Failed timings never rank as completed deliveries.
completion: Attempt all sixteen new jobs within resource limits, preserve failures, validate and inspect successful media, export evidence and reviewable video links. New videos remain human-review pending until separately accepted.

stops.retries: none automatically; any future rerun needs a new evidence path and reason

boundary: Expanded systems comparison, not a new speed optimization. Accepted prior videos and public source examples do not pre-approve new output quality.
